mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness, prompting the Federal Reserve to initiate rate cuts, which boost equity valuations and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust economic activity and strong consumer demand, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in INDPRO and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 indicates weakening manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 108.0 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level above 1300.0 thousand units indicates robust residential construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances when HOUST rises above 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 3.0% indicates persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises above 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized indicates strong economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of quarters with GDPC1 above 2.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) decline below 149,000 thousand indicates economic slowdown, prompting Federal Reserve rate cuts that boost equity valuations and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances when PAYEMS falls below 149000.0.
